Elena —

Thanks for the note and the volume context, that helps a lot. High level answers first, then I attached a short baseline rate card PDF for reference.

- Pricing: hosted embeddings are billed per vector unit for typical workflows (we convert ingest into a per-vector unit). There is no separate per-token charge for standard embedding API calls — token charging applies to text generation endpoints only.
- Dimensions: we support both 1536 and 384 vectors. Unit pricing is model/dimension‑aware; generally higher-dimension vectors have a higher unit cost due to storage and compute.
- Packaging: we offer pay-as-you-go plus committed tiers (monthly/annual) with volume discounts. Commit thresholds start around ~10M vectors/mo for published tiers; we can do custom pricing for higher commitments.

I've attached: redwood_ratecard_baseline.pdf (baseline hosted rates) — see section 2 for embeddings.

Before I put together a couple of concrete packaging options for your 30M mix: can you confirm whether your vectors are:
- stored long-term (index retention >90 days) or ephemeral?
- ingested via batch jobs or real-time single calls (affects caching/batching economics)
- latency sensitivity (SLOs) — e.g., 50ms p50 for retrieve requests?

If it's easier, we can set a 20‑minute sync tomorrow to walk through numbers.

Elena / Rajiv —

Thanks for the details and sorry for the internal loop — below is a concise proposal and the assumptions we used. I've attached a tailored rate card and a draft SOW for your review.

Executive summary
- Billing model: per-vector unit (no additional per-token charge for embedding calls). We normalize mixed-dimension usage by a storage-weighted unit: 384d = 1.0 unit, 1536d = 3.25 units. The 3.25 factor reflects current storage + compute delta for serving and indexing (this value is the recommended commercial unit for hosted tiers).
- Supported models: both common 1536 and 384 open models are supported on hosted embeddings today. We also support custom model variants in Redwood Dedicated/Private but those require separate onboarding.
- Retention/ingest: because you plan >180d retention and heavy batch backfills, we modeled storage impact in the pricing below.

Sample pricing (monthly, USD) — 30M vectors mix (80% 1536, 20% 384)
- Normalized units: (30M * (0.8*3.25 + 0.2*1.0)) = 30M * 2.8 = 84M units
- Pay-as-you-go baseline (from attached baseline ratecard): $0.00055 per unit => Estimated monthly = $46,200
- 12‑month commit (custom tier): proposed unit price = $0.00042 per unit (28% discount) => Estimated monthly = $35,280

Other notes and options
- Indexing/ingest bursts: we recommend enabling prefix/KV caching and batching to reduce write costs; we can configure an initial autoscale policy that limits peak ingest node counts during backfills to control transient cost.
- Retention optimization: if you can tier older vectors into a 'cold storage' export after 180d, we can offer lower storage unit rates for those items — we can model this in an SOW.
- Model SLA: hosted embeddings are covered by our standard API SLA; Dedicated/Private options available for tighter latency/throughput/IS requirements.
